summary: PRF Technologies Ltd. filed a Form 6-K attaching a press release announcing its participation in Energy Trading Week Europe 2026 to showcase its GridFeed platform. The filing is a routine current report of a foreign private issuer regarding a marketing event with no financial terms, M&A activity, or special situation.
